title: Brisket Fatigue Therapy
description: Swedish stranger learns Texas BBQ has a dark, smoky downside when you’re 19 and your soles are screaming.

messages.Ava: decent, tired tho. been up since 6 for work
waitress at this bbq place downtown
pays bills but my feet hate me
yeah the food's fire but after smelling brisket for 8 hrs straight the appeal kinda dies
